scene: a small folded card standing open on a classroom desk, a biro pigeon drawn on the front with its own shadow scribbled underneath it, the fold not quite square, a green plastic pencil pot and a strip of gummed paper tape beside it, flat fluorescent light from above and a smear of dried glue on the desk

a canal towpath in early april seen along its length, a low blossom tree leaning out over the water with half its petals already on the path, still brown-green water holding the reflection, a black iron mooring ring set into the wall, wet gravel and a painted white line, soft overcast light

an open sketchbook on a kitchen table, the right page filled with a hard pencil drawing of a domestic radiator seen straight on, every fin counted and the perspective slightly wrong, eraser crumbs along the gutter, a ballpoint pen lying across the left page and a mug ring in the corner, low window light from the left

a scarred wooden chopping board on a steel kitchen bench with three trimmed leeks laid in a row, dark green tops cut off and pushed to one side, a stalky green vegetable of uncertain species beside them, a small knife with a worn handle, one potato at the back edge, a single warm bulb overhead

four open wooden crates of potatoes on a market trestle under a canvas awning, each crate with a hand-lettered card price sign pushed into the earth on the tubers, loose soil across the boards, a set of brass scales at the edge of frame and wet cobbles below, flat grey morning light

a string net bag of large oranges resting on a kitchen worktop with the receipt folded underneath it, the printed paper curling up at one end, a set of keys and a bus ticket beside the bag, a dark window and a kettle out of focus behind, hard overhead kitchen light

a wide shallow bowl of thick pale green soup on a steel bench, the surface matt and still with a swirl of oil going grey at the edge, a torn heel of dark bread laid across the rim, the heavy enamel pan behind with the ladle standing upright in it, one bare bulb and a dark window

an open sketchbook page filled with a soft pencil drawing of a lidded cooking pan on a hob, the steam above it worked up so heavily in graphite that it has become cloud, smudged fingerprints down the margin, the book weighted flat with a stone, warm lamp light from the right

an official printed letter on a kitchen table with a small passport photograph paper-clipped to the top corner, a printed circle marking the wall behind the head in the photograph, the letter creased in three from the envelope, the torn envelope underneath and a cold mug on the corner, grey daylight from a window

a hospital car park at eight in the morning in april, wet tarmac holding a pink and grey sky, painted bays mostly empty with two cars left overnight and their windscreens fogged, a low barrier and a sodium lamp just gone out, the hill and a line of budding trees beyond the fence
